en.title: Binocular Stereo Vision Camera Module
en.desc: Dual-lens stereo camera module for 3D depth map computation, spatial positioning, and AI object tracking.

raspberryPiWiring.conn: Raspberry Pi 5 USB-A (typical for UVC cameras)
Pi 5 CSI ribbon connector (not GPIO Dupont wiring)

en.codeSnippet:
# Python OpenCV Stereo Capture
import cv2
cap = cv2.VideoCapture(0)
cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH, 2560)
cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT, 720)
while True:
    ret, frame = cap.read()
    left_img = frame[:, :1280]
    right_img = frame[:, 1280:]
    cv2.imshow("Left", left_img)
    if cv2.waitKey(1) == 27: break

name: YourFun NeZha Motor & Servo Controller Board

en.title: YourFun NeZha Motor & Servo Controller Board
en.desc: I2C bus motor and servo driver board designed for smart cars and robotic arms. Features on-board MCU, 4 DC motor channels (M1-M4), 4 servo PWM ports (S1-S4), and 4 RGB LEDs controlled over I2C (default address 0x40).

specs.label: Motor Outputs
specs.val: 4 DC Motor Channels (M1, M2, M3, M4)

specs.label: Servo Outputs
specs.val: 4 Servo PWM Ports (S1, S2, S3, S4)

en.codeSnippet:
# Python example: Control NeZha board over I2C (0x40)
from carbot.nezha import NeZhaBoard

nezha = NeZhaBoard(bus=1, address=0x40)
nezha.set_motor(1, 50)   # Set M1 DC motor to 50% speed
nezha.set_servo(1, 90)   # Set S1 servo angle to 90°

raspberryPiWiring.conn: Connect 11.1V battery (DC 6V-12V) to blue terminal block
⚠️ Do NOT connect NeZha 5V pin to Pi GPIO 5V when board is battery powered (avoids dual power conflict)
